findings.desc: codex host-2: resolveLearningRoot (learning-store.ts:~85) uses dirname(resolve(searchOrigin, git rev-parse --git-common-dir)), which assumes the git common dir lives inside the main checkout (<main>/.git). True for normal checkout + linked worktrees (Orchestrate normal usage), but FALSE for .git-file layouts: git init --separate-git-dir and bare-backed worktrees point --git-common-dir at external git storage, so the resolver returns <storage-parent>/.lattice/learning instead of the checkout root — a correctness regression for those valid git layouts (changes plain-checkout behavior). Fix: resolve the MAIN worktree root via git worktree list --porcelain (first worktree entry), fallback to searchOrigin; that reports actual checkout paths in all layouts.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in e4e278b2: resolveLearningRoot now resolves the main root via git worktree list --porcelain (first entry) when it is a genuine working tree (differs from --git-common-dir; covers normal + linked worktrees -> MAIN root), and falls back to git rev-parse --show-toplevel for separate-git-dir / bare-backed layouts (the actual checkout), with a final fallback to searchOrigin. Smoke extended to 6 checks incl. separate-git-dir + bare-backed; RED/GREEN verified.

findings.desc: misleading-comment: experience-hint-worktree-cache-smoke.ts:290-292 states "git worktree list reports the worktree checkout as the first (main) entry" for a bare-backed worktree — this is factually wrong; git actually reports the BARE REPO dir as the first entry (tagged bare), so the code reaches the correct result via the --show-toplevel fallback, not the first-entry path. The comment inverts the mechanism, misleading future readers about why this case works.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in a9c496f5: corrected the bare-backed + separate-git-dir comments to describe the real mechanism (git worktree list first entry is the external/bare gitdir == --git-common-dir; resolveLearningRoot detects mainWorktree==commonDir and falls back to git rev-parse --show-toplevel). Comment-only; logic unchanged; smoke 6/6.
